FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Questions about recurring invoices

Does Invonxt automatically charge customers?

Automatic charging is not verified in this repository and is not claimed on this page.

Does it automatically email every invoice?

Automatic recurring email delivery is not verified here. Use only the sending options available in your active application.

Can billing frequency be configured?

The existing product messaging describes setting a billing frequency and managing recurring invoice records.

Can recurring records be paused?

The current marketing UI depicts active and paused recurring billing records.
